clauses.reason: Keep exact-object binding and recovery; drop portability and legacy pending completion.

updates.rationale: Local records need integrity against interruption and misuse, not a portable forgery boundary; use-time checks keep the exact-object guarantee at a cost proportional to what an operation consults.
updates.statement: Versioned local structured operations bind source, baseline, qualification and decision mappings to actual immutable Git commits, parents and trees. Pending intent precedes effects, recovery is idempotent and conflicting proof refuses. A record is validated completely when written; reads parse the stored records and check a record's commit, parents and tree against Git where it is used. Legacy history is not rewritten and stays readable through its existing messages, and missing modern authority cannot be manufactured from a message.

clauses.reason: Merges an older engine left pending finish with that engine before an update.

updates.rationale: Exact recorded object identity preserves early provenance enforcement; pending work of an older engine belongs to the batch that engine opened.
updates.statement: A recorded operation persists its pending intent before Git effects. The commit check validates the actual candidate commit, parents and tree against that operation, and completion and retry retain the same identity. New operation messages contain caller-supplied real content without automatically added Signetum trailers or internal tags. Ordinary commits and unrelated merges retain their authorization and project validation rules.

clauses.reason: Legacy compatibility is read-only history, not pending proof.

updates.rationale: Structured exact-object evidence retains every earlier admission and permits safe base advancement without encoding state changes in commit prose.
updates.statement: Batch creation records the fresh delivery tip as its base without executing an obsolete environment. Only a verified batch synchronization operation can merge a later delivered descendant and advance that base; pending, actual commit, parents and tree are durably bound, and a conflict completes through normal continuation first. Existing admissions retain their exact source and evidence and remain bound to the base in effect when admitted. Preparation and the batch gate judge the newly introduced committed range. Retained legacy history stays readable; new messages carry real caller content rather than internal synchronization metadata.

clauses.reason: Synchronization records are checked where they are used.

updates.rationale: The synchronization record supplies the operation authority; checking its Git identity at use keeps that authority without revalidating unrelated records.
updates.statement: A member's synchronization and ratchet baseline come from a durable operation record binding its before tip, authorized source, actual merge commit, parents and tree, checked against Git where it is used. Manual merges or copied messages cannot become synchronization. Recovery resumes that same recorded operation without history rewriting; retained legacy synchronizations remain readable. The latest verified source remains the ratchet baseline, otherwise the registered base, and failures name the normal workspace synchronization recovery.

decisions.reason: Operation records live only in the local Git common directory. Anyone able to forge them can already rewrite refs and history, so field-level forgery defence and portable proof add cost without protection. The real risks are interrupted writes and agents presenting manual merges or copied messages as operations; pending intent before effects, completion bound to actual Git identity, the commit check and use-time object checks cover them. Revalidating every record on every read made operations quadratic in their history and drove the 0.9.2 release over its hosted bound. Structured records never shipped, so removing portability and the legacy cutover machinery strands no consumer; older pending work finishes with the engine that opened its batch. Reopen if records must travel between checkouts or become a shared trust boundary.

transaction.reason: Apply the approved local operation trust decision
